args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP despite the docstring (and FIN-212)
specifying banker's rounding, causing test_half_even in tests/test_money.py
to fail (e.g. 2.665 should round to 2.66, not 2.67).

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py` claimed to implement banker's rounding per FIN-212 (and its docstring says so), but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This broke the nightly build: `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects `2.665 → 2.66`, but half-up produces `2.67`.

## Changes
- Import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `08d3cd5986`, including `test_half_even`.
